primary_outcome: the lineage report the fixed driver prints follows SOP CB-3: passage, doublings, PDL and limit flag per culture; vials left and PDL per bank

obligations.contribution: doublings are log2 of the viable harvest over the viable seed, the seed counted at its source suspension's viability; losses below nought kept

authority.anchor: A culture's **doublings** are the base-two logarithm of the viable count of its

separability.rationale: the figure feeds the PDL, age, flags or bank figures of the same lineage report

obligations.discriminating_instance: harvest and source viabilities that differ (thaw 75.0, harvest 100.0; source harvest 82.5 feeding a culture at 97.0), viability exactly 70.0
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: correct only the harvest, or correct the seed at the culture's own harvest viability so the correction cancels

obligations.contribution: passage number and PDL follow source and vial links; a thaw keeps its vial's harvest figures; a supplier vial starts at the line's seed

authority.anchor: Passage numbers and PDL follow the lineage

separability.rationale: the figure feeds the PDL, age, flags or bank figures of the same lineage report

obligations.discriminating_instance: two lineages of one line interleaved in the log, sister cultures of one harvest, a bank vial thawed after the line has grown on
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: a running PDL and passage per line in log order, one passage added at every thaw, every thaw restarting at the line's seed

obligations.contribution: flags are judged on age, the highest PDL along the lineage: LIMIT above max_pdl, NEAR above max_pdl - 3

authority.anchor: A culture's flag is judged on the age of its harvest

separability.rationale: the figure feeds the PDL, age, flags or bank figures of the same lineage report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a crash after the line passed its maximum; ages 10^-5 either side of max_pdl and of max_pdl - 3
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: judge the flag on the culture's own PDL, or keep a five-doubling band

obligations.contribution: vials left are vials frozen less vials thawed; bank PDL is the highest PDL of the vials still in stock

authority.anchor: bank in use is the highest PDL of its vials in stock

separability.rationale: the figure feeds the PDL, age, flags or bank figures of the same lineage report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a bank of three freezes at rising PDL, the highest one fully thawed; a bank with every vial thawed
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: report the frozen total, the latest freeze's PDL, or the highest PDL of every freeze ever made
